reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model 230LX, which is not a recalled model. The only recalled model is 200LX.
The purchase date of 2016-12-04 is before the program's sale window (2017-05-01 to 2026-02-28), so the purchase is not eligible.
The serial LX002970 falls within a recalled range, but that does not cure the model mismatch or the out-of-window purchase.
